court_from_credit.speaker: lin_yue
court_from_credit.text: The bridge had closed on time. I carried the certificate which said two unused furnace hours had returned to their owners, beside the report of slots the bridge could not fill. The court's request did not erase those losses. At the city gate, another petitioner waited with an injured porter and a stonebinder's tool roll. Their papers concerned the court's own rain stair. The messenger joined their petition to the certified city record because an old license annex appeared in both files. Joining papers, I hoped, would not turn separate troubles into one accusation.

court_from_ledgers.speaker: mei_dulan
court_from_ledgers.text: I gave the messenger two certified extracts, not a third book pretending our work was finished. The public proof correction stood; the commercial account still contained a disputed return price. A porter named Du Heng had received his corrected work proof before an accident at the court's lower landing. His petition now carried an older license annex. I enclosed the correction history so the court could see which paper had been superseded. Nobody authorized me to supply his medical history, and the extract contained none. A clean column must not become permission to read its neighbor.

court_from_pool.speaker: tao_wen
court_from_pool.text: The pool sent its chosen delegate with the minutes and paid for no expedition beyond the journey it had approved. People who had declined membership remained outside that mandate. I took the orchard's delivery acknowledgment to the meeting, then returned it to its owner. The court wanted the city's hearing record, not custody of every useful receipt. A new accident petition had reached its lower gate. The messenger said a copied license annex had complicated the porter's filing. We packed the rules of the pool beside the disagreement about its delivery charges, leaving the disagreement legible.

court_from_audit.speaker: lin_yue
court_from_audit.text: Tuesday's audit left checked collars in service and several return prices unresolved. I copied the next appointment into my travel book before following the court messenger. The corrected work proofs would remain valid while we were away. At the gate, a woman carrying stone tools asked whether the messenger had brought her missing maintenance annex. He had brought the city hearing record instead. We compared their titles without opening the sealed pages. Two different disputes had passed through the same copying office. That was reason to examine the papers carefully, not proof that one answer would settle both.

court_arrival.speaker: narrator
court_arrival.text: The court stood on a cliff beyond the city's northern road, with rain falling beneath its lowest gallery. Azure Cloud's fate had no bearing on these foundations. A covered path climbed through the mist; above it, roof tiles shone like dark fish scales. Lin Yue stopped where a porter could rest beside a freight notice. The city messenger went ahead with the sealed copy, promising a receipt rather than a hearing. From the lower landing came the sound of a rope knocking against wood. The freight lift had been closed, but the rain had not stopped working.

court_wayhouse.speaker: shen_qing
court_wayhouse.text: The waiting room has dry benches, drinking water, and a stove somebody must refill. I had imagined immortals could make warmth last without fuel. The attendant laughed and showed me the charcoal account. She saved the nearest bench for a traveler who could not lean comfortably on his right arm. A bell rang overhead while she fetched a folded blanket. Nobody moved. This bell announced a change of court watch, she explained, not the start of our appointment. I wrote its meaning down. Arriving early would be useless if we obeyed the wrong sound.

court_sling_notice.speaker: narrator
court_sling_notice.text: A red board prohibited operation of the counterweighted goods lift pending inspection. Below it, a different notice described supervised carrying cradles along the covered footpath. Their attendants checked the path before each reserved trip and could cancel it. They were no substitute for repairing the lift. Lin Yue traced the route with a finger while the messenger asked how to deliver the exhibits. Small packets could travel with a walker; heavy loads would wait. The distinction made the journey slower. It also prevented a hearing reservation from quietly becoming an order to use the equipment under investigation.

court_du_heng.speaker: du_heng
court_du_heng.text: I am thirty-one, and I know how often people hear porter and imagine a back without a person attached. The bandage is on my right shoulder. The clinician told me to rest it, lift no loads, and return for review. That instruction has not become easier because I need my wages. I can tell you what I felt when the sling jerked and what I saw afterward. I cannot tell you which hidden part moved first. Please write those as different things. The first petition made them sound like a single answer I had already given.

court_bai_qun.speaker: bai_qun
court_bai_qun.text: My braid is turning silver faster than my tools are wearing out. I am forty-four, not the ancient contractor the first clerk drew in his margin. I inspect the landing stone, the guide groove, and the mooring pin before the day's work. The lift staff maintain the brake and counterweight. Those duties meet at the landing, which makes the boundary worth writing carefully. I have not brought a tool to show I could never make a mistake. I brought the contract because a mistake in its copied boundary can put somebody else's whole machine into my hands.

court_case_sequence.speaker: luo_shan
court_case_sequence.text: Two days before your arrival, a descending goods sling slipped at the lower landing. The accident report places it at the third market bell. Du Heng injured his right shoulder. Bai Qun's inspection and the repair of the brake or counterweight are now disputed; accounts also differ about when a safety rope appeared. That is the sequence claimed by the report, not a judgment. I will put the date and the source beside each statement. If you remember another event, we can add it without making the first page disappear. A corrected account should show its corrections.

court_luo_shan.speaker: luo_shan
court_luo_shan.text: My name is Luo Shan. I am thirty-nine and work as a petition writer in the court's paid assistance post. I can help you state a request, arrange a room, and record the words you approve. I cannot issue a ruling or certify a document merely by touching it. An authorized clerk performs that task. My pay already comes from the assistance account. You do not owe me a share of your claim for sitting at this table. If a question concerns your private expenses rather than the petition, I will ask why the court needs it.

court_calendar.speaker: narrator
court_calendar.text: The ordinary verification calendar allowed seventy-five days for unsettled classifications of evidence. To the immortal clerks, its intervals prevented hasty judgments. To Du, they contained rent, meals, treatment, and a shoulder whose next review fell in a week. He Lian came down the covered path to receive the emergency petitions in the lower waiting room. The magistrate looked about sixty-two; her face gave no useful measure of how many calendars she had signed. She listened while Luo read both descriptions beside the same date box. A long rule could still contain a shorter emergency procedure.

court_clerk_question.speaker: narrator
court_clerk_question.text: The clerk who received the city copy found a condensed license annex in the accident file. Its columns named temporary recognition use, but a later heading described work authority more broadly. He did not know whether that heading had affected the assessment against Bai. The original court request had sought the city's hearing record to examine precisely this problem. Lin Yue asked that the annex be read beside its source, not discarded before comparison. The clerk marked the request received. He could keep both versions in view without claiming that either paper had become a second independent witness.

court_city_proof.speaker: mei_dulan
court_city_proof.text: Du's corrected work proof is valid now. The city has already restored the public records it had wrongly treated as commercial security, and that correction does not wait for this court to improve its calendar. Here is the registrar's countersigned warrant and the permitted extract of its application. The genuine rental and return-price questions remain in a different account. This petition concerns a new accident and the handling of its evidence. A clerk may verify the source of a submitted copy; he may not make Du purchase his own name again while waiting for that verification.

court_scope.speaker: lin_yue
court_scope.text: A licensed face changes outward features and the permitted voice. It does not supply a maintenance skill, read a wearer's memory, or transfer a person into a contract. I placed that sentence beside the condensed annex because its broader heading might otherwise conceal the boundary. The court need not inspect Du's private true identity to understand the error. He has offered his valid work proof for this filing. If another fact is necessary, somebody must name it and explain why. We have brought evidence from the city, not an invitation to examine every life behind its masks.

court_accident_remit.speaker: bai_qun
court_accident_remit.text: Please read the paragraph after the duty list. My daily walk covers the landing, guide groove, and mooring pin. It does not certify the brake or the counterweight, which the lift staff inspect under a separate schedule. I can answer for my own entries and explain where I stood. I cannot reconstruct another worker's inspection because our boots used the same path. If the court finds my landing work deficient, it should say which part and on what evidence. The copied short form says lift maintenance. That phrase is too large to tell anybody what I promised.

court_upper_bench.speaker: he_lian
court_upper_bench.text: The court's own staircase gives us no exemption from examining its records. I am the bench magistrate, He Lian. I can issue the receipt and temporary protection allowed by our charter, and I can require this office to preserve its filing history. I cannot make a damaged shoulder wait more comfortably by declaring seventy-five days brief. Nor can I assign fault before the parties have answered the evidence. Bring me the requests separately: one for access, one for the disputed assessment, and one for the schedule. A single sweeping plea would leave their boundaries difficult to enforce.

court_emergency_rule.speaker: luo_shan
court_emergency_rule.text: The emergency receipt rule is already part of the court's charter. It permits an evidentiary extension and temporary protection when delay would frustrate a claim before verification can finish. It does not award damages, erase genuine debts, or certify that a machine is safe. I read the conditions aloud, then asked Bai and Du which requests they wished to make. They corrected my description of the work restriction before signing. A rule printed in an upper office is not much help unless the people below can find its name, its limits, and the person responsible for receiving it.

court_relief_request.speaker: du_heng
court_relief_request.text: I want the record-based work bar lifted. That is different from asking to carry a load tomorrow. My shoulder still cannot do it. I also want the disputed accident assessment held while somebody checks whose duty the paper actually describes. I am not asking the court to pay every bill by noon or to clear Bai because I know her. The sling slipped and I was hurt. Those facts deserve an answer which does not borrow a conclusion from a copied heading. Please give me a dated acknowledgment I can show a desk without explaining the whole accident again.

court_immediate_relief.speaker: narrator
court_immediate_relief.text: He Lian signed the receipt order before any investigation was chosen. The valid corrected proofs were admitted. Collection of the disputed new civil assessment and the record-based work bar were suspended while evidence was received. The filing gained seven days, with review on Day Seven. Genuine charges remained separately claimable, and the order awarded no injury compensation. An existing ninety-six-copper access appropriation became available for specified assistance. Du read the work-bar paragraph twice. The order allowed him to seek work consistent with his restrictions; it did not order his shoulder to become ready.

court_safe_closure.speaker: shen_qing
court_safe_closure.text: The goods lift stayed closed. I carried the order down because an impatient supplier had heard work bar lifted and assumed his freight could move. He pointed to crates already paid for. I understood the expense; I also understood the red board. The attendant offered a small-packet route with its own limits, then wrote down the crates it could not take. We could remove a defective record barrier without removing a physical safety barrier. The supplier kept his claim for the delayed service. He would need that honest list more than another confident promise about tomorrow.

court_clinician_note.speaker: narrator
court_clinician_note.text: Du approved a narrow statement of his lifting restriction and next review, not the release of his complete treatment notes. Luo made the distinction on the exhibit cover. The clinician had recommended rest, ordinary care, and review rather than a guaranteed recovery date. Lin Yue offered to fetch water; Du asked instead for the cup to be placed within reach of his left hand. The small adjustment required no cultivation. Outside, two attendants checked a carrying cradle on the covered path. If positioning hurt or the weather made the route unsafe, his statement could travel without him.

court_need_money.speaker: narrator
court_need_money.text: The access ledger contained ninety-six copper from an existing court appropriation, not a new promise to make every loss whole. Sixty-four was assigned to bounded transport, attendance, extracts, storage, and assistance. Thirty-two remained for a later plan. Luo placed the ledger where the parties could read it without surrendering their private household accounts. Ordinary court chairs and his assistance post were already paid elsewhere. Bai asked whether the attendance allocation covered her entire missed day. It did not. The writer added that gap beside the payment so nobody could mistake a small provision for full compensation.

court_custody.speaker: luo_shan
court_custody.text: An exhibit offered for comparison is not a gift to the court. I have written the keeper, permitted use, return date, and approved copying scope on each cover. Originals may remain with their owners while certified extracts travel. If a later task needs another page or a longer storage period, we must request it separately. Money for storage does not enlarge permission to read. We will also preserve the version first received, even when somebody corrects it. The correction belongs beside the earlier account so a future reader can follow what changed without guessing.

court_echo_custody.speaker: mo_ran
court_echo_custody.text: My returned echo case is still sealed beneath my coat. The unidentified third ring remains with the Eel under our landing agreement. Neither belongs in this petition, and neither can answer the lift's clock question. A clerk noticed the cord while asking what property we carried. I named it without offering its contents. He put a line through the unnecessary property question and kept the correction visible. I have spent enough years being described by what others thought a vessel contained. Today the useful thing I can offer is a steady hand carrying a permitted copy.

court_witness_terms.speaker: lin_yue
court_witness_terms.text: Permission to speak at the city hearing ended at that hearing's boundary. Here we must ask again. A witness can offer a written account, approve a specific extract, request a reader, or decline an appearance that costs too much time or pain. Those choices do not erase the observations already properly offered. We will identify who watched an event and who later heard about it. If a writer translates or condenses, the source should see the result before approval. I want the court to hear mortal voices without turning their willingness into an unlimited obligation to keep talking.

court_rain_heron.speaker: narrator
court_rain_heron.text: The Rain Heron stood inside the roofed rail with one foot tucked beneath its pale feathers. Water shivered on the long edge of its beak. It had come to discuss its weather log, not to perform a flight for the bench. A clerk moved an inkstone away from the bird's feet, and the Heron moved it back where it could reach the offered surface. The exchange needed neither reverence nor a handler's command. The observer wanted to know which dates the petition concerned and what the court planned to do with a copied entry.

court_heron_terms.speaker: rain_heron
court_heron_terms.text: I can describe weather I observed from the places named in my log. I cannot show you every drop that fell two days ago. I will not fly the closed outer spur to make an answer look impressive. Bring your questions to the inner rail. If I offer two extracts from one page, count one source, not two birds. Payment can be arranged as a fish invoice at the stated value; that does not buy a prediction without limits. I will examine the proposed copy before deciding whether it says what I actually offered.

court_marketing_clock.speaker: narrator
court_marketing_clock.text: Luo drew three small circles on a scrap: market bell, lower-landing clock, and court watch. The accident report named the first. Other papers used the second or the third without noting a comparison. A current signal test might reveal today's differences. It could not automatically carry those differences backward through a repair or a missed winding. Shen remembered the waiting-room bell and added its meaning below the circles. They needed a usable sequence before they needed a perfectly neat hour. A blank or bounded interval would be more honest than a precise number borrowed from the wrong instrument.

court_terrain.speaker: narrator
court_terrain.text: The terrace map showed the roofed inner measuring square, a sheltered stair, and an exposed outer spur crossed out in red. All three had been abbreviated terrace. The Heron tapped the inner rail; that was where one offered observation had been made. The clerk amended the map key and kept the shortened label visible in the earlier copy. None of these places was Azure Cloud. A gust drove mist against the closed spur while the measuring square remained calm. Even a true account of rain could mislead if its reader put the observer on the wrong side of a roof.

court_small_meal.speaker: shen_qing
court_small_meal.text: The soup had one broad bean in my bowl and three in Luo's. He offered to exchange them, then said we should stop making an appeal out of lunch. We laughed quietly because Du had fallen asleep on the near bench. Bai sharpened no tools while eating; she said grit spoiled everything twice. The attendant marked another charcoal measure used. The court's towers looked timeless from the road, but here every warm thing had a schedule and a keeper. I took my bowl back before offering to wash it. The attendant preferred that we leave her narrow work space clear.

court_names.speaker: luo_shan
court_names.text: A work proof establishes the public claim it is authorized to establish. It is not a license for me to ask who a performer resembles in private. Du has approved his work name for this petition. Bai has approved hers and the relevant contract description. Other people's family details remain outside the copy. I read those cover instructions before writing the case title. Titles travel farther than the room in which they are made. If ours names every bystander as a party, somebody may later treat a small useful observation as consent to answer the entire dispute.

court_competing_claims.speaker: narrator
court_competing_claims.text: The lift office offered repair invoices and a report of delayed freight. Those losses were not imaginary simply because its filing had defects. He Lian admitted the documents for the stated purposes and asked which charges were being assessed against Bai. The office could answer through its authorized keeper rather than every worker who had touched a rope. Lin Yue watched the clerk place the invoices beside, rather than over, Du's petition. A repair price described a cost. Assigning that cost to a person required another argument, and the emergency stay gave that argument time to be heard.

court_first_copy.speaker: narrator
court_first_copy.text: The first working copy arrived with a folded corner hiding the paragraph after Bai's duty list. The messenger unfolded it without smoothing away the crease. The clerk recorded the defect and compared the supplied page with the authorized extract. Nobody called the crease deliberate. Lin Yue asked for the missing paragraph to be read before any summary of the maintenance claim. The simple act took less than a minute. It changed the question from who maintained the lift to who had promised which inspection. The original accusation remained in the file, now accompanied by the words it had omitted.

court_time_budget.speaker: du_heng
court_time_budget.text: My reserved visit cannot last until everybody finishes asking the same question differently. The attendants have a return time, and the clinician said I should not stay in one position too long. I want an interval for rest written into the appointment, not something I must earn by becoming visibly worse. Luo showed me the local-statement option if the journey could not happen safely. I chose the planned visit for now. Choosing it today does not mean I will choose it tomorrow. Please leave a way to tell the desk I have changed my mind.

court_day_plan.speaker: he_lian
court_day_plan.text: Today is Day Zero of this extension. We will gather the authorized findings over the next two days and convene the common hearing on Day Three. The canal bulletin presently warns of possible closure on Day Five; it is a forecast to assess, not a command that weather must obey. Review of the extension falls on Day Seven. Put those dates beside the ordinary seventy-five-day rule. I want every recipient to know which order governs the immediate petition and where unanswered questions will go. No witness must infer a deadline from how slowly an immortal rises from a chair.

court_team_map.speaker: lin_yue
court_team_map.text: We can follow four lines of inquiry without making every witness walk all four paths. One team will arrange testimony and separate observation from inference. Another will examine the offered weather records and the limits of their clocks. A third will account for access costs, real claims, and the money left unspent. The last will follow the docket's versions and authority to correct them. I will accompany one team. The others will keep their own approved exhibits and report at the common hearing. My presence cannot be the condition which makes their work worth considering.

court_report_rule.speaker: luo_shan
court_report_rule.text: Each packet must state its source, permission, method, finding, and limit. A copied annotation does not become another witness by arriving in another envelope. When teams disagree, preserve the disagreement and identify what could resolve it. Please do not turn an unanswered question into an accusation for the sake of completing the form. We have enough room to write unknown. At the hearing, the people authorized to answer can inspect the summary before the bench relies on it. Lin Yue may report what one route showed; the remaining three reports belong to their own makers.

court_investigation_choice.speaker: lin_yue
court_investigation_choice.text: The rain has reached the lower roof, and our first appointments are ready. I must choose where to spend these two days. The witness route will reveal the cost and shape of an account spoken by a finite person. The weather route will test what clocks and gauges can honestly tell us. The cost route will distinguish assistance from compensation and a reservation from a payment. The docket route will follow which official can change which record. All four teams will return their authorized findings. Choosing one gives me a closer view, not the power to silence the others.

choices.text: Follow the witnesses and make room for their finite days.
Examine the rain records, gauges, and clocks.
Trace access costs and the remaining assistance fund.
Compare the docket's versions and correction authority.

court_findings.speaker: narrator
court_findings.text: On Day Three, the court opened the common hearing before mist had left its windows. Four packets lay on separate cloths, each with a keeper and permitted-use cover. Lin Yue placed her route's packet beside the others. The clerk read sources rather than ranking messengers. Bai and Du had approved readings from below; neither funded journey was repeated. Their responses could travel through the named contact without another ascent. The bench began with the emergency order so nobody could mistake this hearing for its cancellation. Each approved statement named its speaker and a contact for replies.

court_witness_report.speaker: luo_shan
court_witness_report.text: Bai's account describes landing and guide inspection, not knowledge of the brake. Du's first report saying no rope remains beside his approved correction: he did not see one before the jolt, saw one after injury, and cannot date its installation. Su E heard the market third bell without a precise court-clock conversion. Chen Yuan saw an unidentified coil after a shout, not a named safety rope being first fastened. Ning Yu observed later assistance from an obstructed position. Earlier accounts, influences, and approved corrections remain paired. Reading these observations together does not make them a complete view.

court_witness_dissent.speaker: narrator
court_witness_dissent.text: An attendance summary still used absent beside a person who had supplied an approved written statement. The witness team's cover challenged that label. He Lian asked the clerk to distinguish a declined appearance, a failed notice, a canceled safe journey, and a missing answer. The new headings did not pretend every account was complete. They prevented an access failure from quietly becoming evidence against its subject. The approved response from below asked that the original remain attached. A person had lost time explaining it once; a future reader should see why the line needed correction.

court_rain_report.speaker: rain_heron
court_rain_report.text: The gauge comparison concerns the present instrument under a controlled pour. A tilted mount caught less of that measured water; adjusting the mount changed the result. That is useful evidence about a measurement problem today. It does not restore the exact rain which fell on the accident day. Zhong Rui's offered slate dates a gauge-support replacement to the following day. Keep that date beside the comparison. I offered observations from the roofed inner rail, not the closed outer spur. My weather log names its places. The shortened copies must return those names to the account.

court_clock_difference.speaker: narrator
court_clock_difference.text: The team placed the current clock comparison on the table without assigning its offsets to the past. Their visible signals showed why market bell, lower-landing clock, and court watch needed separate labels. A wet trace at the landing could establish neither an exact hour nor the first mechanical failure. The clerk had expected a single corrected time to fit his neat box. He drew an interval instead and attached the reasons its ends remained uncertain. The change made the form less tidy. It also stopped the uncertainty from being concealed inside a number which none of the observers had supplied.

court_forecast_limit.speaker: rain_heron
court_forecast_limit.text: The offered log and the dated revision of the canal bulletin narrow what warnings were available and when they were issued. Two extracts from my page remain one source. They do not become independent agreement by wearing different seals. The current bulletin warns of possible closure on Day Five, with conditions the forecaster has stated. It is sufficient reason to plan a safer schedule, not proof that the canal must close at an exact bell. I will not fill the remaining interval by making a dangerous flight. The closed outer spur remains closed to our work.

court_cost_report.speaker: luo_shan
court_cost_report.text: The access account begins with ninety-six copper already appropriated. Its baseline reserves sixty-four: sixteen for two assisted round trips, twenty for four bounded attendance allocations, eight for two certified extracts, twelve for six storage nights, and eight for handcart and attendant assistance. Reserved and actually paid amounts have separate marks. Ordinary staff salaries and chairs are not charged again. Thirty-two remains for one additional plan. If a reserved service is canceled, unused money returns under the account's rule. It does not automatically become a larger personal award. The ledger shows assistance, not the full cost of being hurt.

court_unfunded_need.speaker: du_heng
court_unfunded_need.text: Five copper for an attendance interval helps. It does not replace every load I cannot carry, and it does not pay my complete treatment bill. I signed the receipt because the interval was provided, not because I agreed my loss had ended. The cost team kept that sentence. I want it read beside the neat total. A claim for recovery expenses still needs its own evidence and answer. Today I need the desk to stop using the accident filing as a reason to bar work my clinician would permit. That does not mean I can safely resume my old route.

court_docket_report.speaker: luo_shan
court_docket_report.text: The source city judgment, Du's corrected work proof, and the condensed temporary-license annex establish different things. The docket packet preserves their versions instead of substituting one for another. Copies and annotations derived from the same source do not count as independent testimony. The court's seventy-five-day verification cycle is a genuine rule for unsettled evidentiary classifications, but this petition already has a binding emergency extension and review date. A corrected desk display cannot secretly repeal or enlarge either rule. The packet names who can amend a notice, who certifies an extract, and which changes require the bench's order.

court_department_reply.speaker: narrator
court_department_reply.text: The lift office's keeper acknowledged that the condensed duty heading did not reproduce Bai's complete scope. He disputed whether the missing words had determined the assessment and asked to submit the original calculation. He Lian allowed a dated, particular reply within the existing protection rather than accepting the keeper's recollection as the missing calculation. The office would have to identify the charge and its claimed basis. A concession about a defective copy was not a confession to causing the accident. The clerk entered both parts of the response, leaving room for the requested document and an answer to it.

court_bai_reply.speaker: bai_qun
court_bai_reply.text: I will answer a particular claim about my landing work. I will not accept a sentence assigning the whole lift to me because it is shorter to copy. The source contract is here with the relevant paragraph, and the statement about my walk remains my account of that walk. If another observer contradicts it, tell me what they actually observed. Do not ask me to prove that no unseen part could have failed. A person can be responsible for a promised inspection without owning every cause in a machine. I need the court to hold those two thoughts at once.

court_du_reply.speaker: du_heng
court_du_reply.text: I want a decision which lets my next treatment visit happen without another argument about whether I am allowed to have a work account. The proof question is already corrected. The injury question remains real. I cannot improve the evidence by giving the bench a more certain version of the jolt. When I described the rope afterward, I meant afterward. The writer showed me the difference before I approved the statement. If the court needs another examination, it should tell me what it may answer and what it will cost, not announce that a healed arm will explain everything.

court_visible_limits.speaker: narrator
court_visible_limits.text: Lin Yue set the packets' limitation pages beside their findings. The arrangement looked awkward; the court's long table had been built for aligned seals. One page said no exact past rainfall. Another said no direct view of the first mechanical failure. A third disclosed unpaid losses. The fourth distinguished a copying correction from a liability decision. He Lian asked the clerk to include those pages in every authorized summary. The packets offered more knowledge than they had brought on arrival. Their usefulness depended on retaining the places where that knowledge ended, rather than clipping them for a graceful conclusion.

court_scope_test.speaker: he_lian
court_scope_test.text: The submitted maintenance source does not authorize this office to treat Bai's daily landing and guide inspection as a promise to maintain the separate brake and counterweight. The broad heading cannot supply the missing promise. This finding concerns the scope of the filed claim. It does not certify that Bai's own work was faultless or identify what first caused the sling to slip. A particular claim may still be presented with its proper source and an opportunity to answer. Until then, a convenient summary will not carry a burden the underlying contract does not contain.

court_no_cause_verdict.speaker: narrator
court_no_cause_verdict.text: The magistrate declined the request for an immediate complete fault judgment. The offered records did not establish the first failure with the certainty that request assumed. She distinguished that refusal from doing nothing. The administrative defect could be corrected now; the unsupported broad assessment could be set aside as filed; the safety closure could remain; and the particular injury and maintenance questions could receive a dated route forward. Bai exhaled without cheering. Du asked the clerk to read the next review date again. Neither needed the court to invent innocence or guilt in order to stop enforcing the defective page.

court_public_rights.speaker: mei_dulan
court_public_rights.text: The city correction remains in force. This court's receipt admits the corrected work proof, and today's order does not turn its validity into a reward for helping further reform. Workers who decline new testimony keep their corrected records. Genuine commercial claims remain separately auditable, with no automatic forgiveness and no permanent-name pledge resurrected from the old annex. I ask for that distinction in the notice sent back to the registry. The notice should be something a desk can apply during an ordinary trading day, not a phrase whose protection lasts only while the magistrate is listening.

court_payable_claim.speaker: narrator
court_payable_claim.text: The clerk read the remaining invoices by category: provided service, disputed assignment, proposed repair, and claimed loss. Some described genuine costs while leaving their payer unsettled. Luo wrote those boundaries instead of putting every figure into a single debt total. The emergency protection did not make charcoal free or compensate every waiting supplier. It did prevent a defective administrative assignment from collecting first and explaining itself later. The office's next submission would name a particular basis for any renewed assessment. Bai could answer it without accepting that a real expense must therefore be her own obligation.

court_notice_repair.speaker: he_lian
court_notice_repair.text: The office will replace the shortened desk instruction with the applicable conditions and dates, preserving the superseded version in the record. The clerk may correct a display; only an authorized order may alter the governing schedule. A person who relied on our shortened instruction must have a route to seek review of the resulting absence or lateness label. We will identify a receiving post at the lower gate. This does not mean every late document becomes persuasive. It means the office cannot hide its own notice failure inside a presumption that a mortal had ample time.

court_existing_protection.speaker: narrator
court_existing_protection.text: The new order confirmed the relief already granted and set aside the broad assessment as submitted. It left properly specified future claims possible under notice and reply, without reviving the work bar through the defective annex. The goods lift retained its independent safety process. An ordinary staff messenger took the concise approved copy below. Du pressed it flat with his left thumb while Luo explained where another desk could verify it. The paper would not feed him or mend the shoulder. It removed one expensive argument from the path to doing those things. No additional ascent was required.

court_private_account.speaker: narrator
court_private_account.text: During the recess, a supplier asked whether the new order settled the city's disputed return prices. Mo Ran shook his head and showed him the category heading in the authorized notice. The supplier wanted a broader answer; his payment was overdue. Luo offered the address of the separate commercial desk, not the contents of another person's private file. After the man left, Mo tightened the cord of his sealed echo case. Public clarity could still have narrow borders. Lin Yue returned from the water bench with the hearing copy, leaving the unrelated accounts exactly where their owners had placed them.

court_stair_pause.speaker: narrator
court_stair_pause.text: A lull opened in the rain, and Shen walked to the inner rail without crossing the red barrier. The exposed spur glistened under a clear strip of sky, tempting as an answer which looked complete from a distance. Below, attendants waited with an empty carrying cradle rather than promising a trip before their route check. Shen watched a handcart turn back with a load too heavy for the covered path. The delay cost its owner something real. Calling the path safe for every task would only add another false assurance to an already expensive afternoon.

court_room_after.speaker: bai_qun
court_room_after.text: I approved the account read upstairs without returning to the bench. I expected to want my tools as soon as the hearing stopped. Instead I want to sit in the lower room without proving the sitting is productive. The court corrected the scope of my promise. It has not told me what happened inside the lift or made the unanswered claim disappear. Du asked whether I would inspect another landing when my time was free. I said I would read the contract first. We laughed because that sounded like my old caution returning, rather than somebody taking it away.

court_hand_off.speaker: luo_shan
court_hand_off.text: Each party now receives the order and the approved portion of the hearing account. The original exhibits follow their keeper's terms. Storage through the six reserved nights does not authorize us to retain an original after its return date, and extra funds do not alter that. We can request a renewed period for permitted copies if a later plan requires it. The cost ledger will name who receives unused reserves. I have also left a place for an objection to my transcript. Being paid to write your words gives me a duty to show you what I wrote.

court_remaining_fund.speaker: narrator
court_remaining_fund.text: Thirty-two copper remained available for one additional plan. The bench displayed four budgets beside four proposed schedules. All drew on existing funds; none depended on an unoffered private guarantee or a stream of free cultivation. The first could support bounded weather observations. The second could bring limited testimony work to the lower landing. The third could stage specified source checks and handling. The fourth could obtain a single independent reinspection through a dated remand. Each retained expenses and questions it could not cover. The magistrate asked which purpose the parties could accept without pretending its neighbors had also been paid.

court_weather_offer.speaker: rain_heron
court_weather_offer.text: A station can improve a future bulletin from a safe place with paid observers. It cannot reveal the past inside today's rain. Extra shifts remain separate from the lift keeper's ordinary duty and from my offered account. Lin Yue can demonstrate a grounded reference wick within her measured allowance. We must repeat the signal with a shuttered lantern before adopting it. Later observers inherit that ordinary method, not her continued attendance. Name the stopping conditions and missing views beside the price.

court_local_offer.speaker: du_heng
court_local_offer.text: I am answering from below. The lower landing is easier to reach than the upper hall, provided the rented room is actually sheltered and somebody checks its access. Two local sessions could let a person correct a copied sentence without spending a day climbing. They would still cost time, and a person could still decline. I do not want the desk to label a local answer inferior merely because the witness stayed near home. I also do not want every neighbor required to speak because the room has been paid for. The transcript should keep offer, answer, and limits separate.

court_staged_offer.speaker: luo_shan
court_staged_offer.text: A staged docket would accept the established administrative findings now and reserve particular source questions for paid checking blocks. That is not a way to hide the injury claim in a second book. The stages need names, dates, responsible posts, and a route for either party to challenge a mistaken placement. The proposed six checking hours are finite. Specialist exhibit handling covers two stated tasks, not unlimited examinations. If those tasks leave a question unresolved, the record must say so. We can make the next question smaller without disguising it as a conclusion already reached.

court_remand_offer.speaker: he_lian
court_remand_offer.text: The dated remand would request one independent lower-landing reinspection and a particular supplemental extract. It would preserve the findings and protection already issued while returning unanswered maintenance questions to the proper receiving office. A new inspection concerns conditions it can presently observe; it is not a machine for replaying the accident. The office must name its reply date and show why any delay is necessary. At Day Seven, we will review authority and permitted custody rather than assume both continue by silence. This is a bounded way forward even if no additional witness chooses another session.

court_permission_review.speaker: lin_yue
court_permission_review.text: Before choosing, we sent the offers to their makers through approved contacts. A room reservation did not reserve its witnesses. An instrument rental did not purchase the Heron's attention. A storage line did not add pages to exhibit permissions. Bai and Du could approve the relevant use of their offered statements while declining a further task or journey. The lift office could inspect the particular claim it must answer. The clerk marked replies beside the proposals, including conditions and refusals. The budget's numbers and the people's agreements would remain different kinds of entry on the issued plan.

court_next_notice.speaker: narrator
court_next_notice.text: Luo prepared the notice form before the bench chose its plan. He left the task box blank and filled the lines which would be true under every option: corrected proofs admitted, defective broad assessment set aside, particular claims requiring notice and reply, goods-lift closure governed by safety, Day Seven review. The lower-gate receiving post and the method of checking the order appeared on its face. Lin Yue asked him to include the office's shortened-notice correction. A future traveler should not need this afternoon's entire conversation to learn that the emergency receipt rule existed or where to ask for it.

court_measured_risk.speaker: shen_qing
court_measured_risk.text: I understand why an immortal office wants a patient record. I also understand that a record can become less patient with people than with paper. The answer cannot be to treat every uncertain claim as settled by urgency. We can meet a deadline, preserve the source, pay a bounded task, and say what remains unknown. That is slower than one brilliant revelation and faster than abandoning the matter for seventy-five days. The clerk read Du's approved words, pauses included. His absence from this upper room did not make the person waiting less present in our measure of the procedure.

court_failure_clause.speaker: he_lian
court_failure_clause.text: The selected plan will include a failure report. If weather cancels a shift, access prevents a session, permission limits a check, or the reinspection cannot answer the historical question, the responsible post must record that fact before claiming completion. Unused reserves return according to the appropriation. Existing rights and today's administrative findings do not depend on the plan succeeding. Further storage after its authorized period requires renewed permission and authority, even where money remains. We will not improve the calendar by buying a silence in which its unanswered questions can disappear from view.

court_people_after_order.speaker: narrator
court_people_after_order.text: The clerk sent four proposal receipts below, one for each task. Du's written question asked whether he had to sign them all to keep the order. He Lian answered no; the response entered the minutes and returned through the named contact. Only the selected plan would be funded. Participation in a new task remained separately agreed. Bai set the unused forms aside. Lin Yue read that exchange beside the findings. A person who has spent days defending a valid proof can hear blank signatures as another condition of keeping it. The court needed to answer that fear explicitly.

court_return_dates.speaker: narrator
court_return_dates.text: Mo Ran checked the permitted packets' return dates before the decision. Some originals had never left their owners; others had named pickup arrangements. Extra storage covered only agreed copies and tasks, with renewal where required. He put return dates on a carrying list which revealed no private contents. The Day Seven review would use approved accounts and named lower contacts; neither funded ascent was repeated. Lin Yue would carry the hearing copy. Rain found a new rhythm beyond the door, though canal closure remained conditional and the hidden failure unknown.

court_final_choice.speaker: lin_yue
court_final_choice.text: We have corrected the unsupported broad assessment and preserved the rights already restored in the city. The injury and particular maintenance claims still need their proper answers. Thirty-two copper can fund one bounded next step: safe weather observations, local testimony sessions, staged source checks, or a dated independent reinspection. None buys certainty about the accident, and none can make the court's protection depend on another person's unpaid labor. We should choose the task we can carry out under its stated permissions and dates, keep its failures visible, and return to review the questions it leaves open.

choices.text: Fund a safe, bounded weather station and visible signal demonstration.
Bring two separately agreed testimony sessions to the lower landing.
Stage the evidence docket with paid source checks and handling.
Issue a dated limited remand for one independent reinspection.

court_weather_proposal.speaker: lin_yue
court_weather_proposal.text: I proposed the station with its whole thirty-two-copper budget visible: eighteen for three independent observer shifts, six for the instrument rental, four for dated public notices, and four for two further storage nights under permitted custody. The shifts run through Day Five, with review on Day Seven. They are not the lift keeper's ordinary safety duty charged under another name. My qi can demonstrate a narrow signal between sheltered posts today. Paid observers must run the later work without depending on me to stay. The station records its present weather; it does not purchase the accident's missing past.

court_weather_terms.speaker: rain_heron
court_weather_terms.text: I approved the offered log copy, not a new flight. The hired observer showed me the station position and the description of its roof shelter. I asked him to keep that location on each sheet. A reading from here should not claim to describe the outer spur without saying how the inference was made. He agreed to mark uncertainty in the bulletin. The instrument belongs to its keeper and will return after the rental. If a shift cannot be performed safely, its cancellation goes into the report. Silence is not a reading of clear weather.

court_weather_setup.speaker: narrator
court_weather_setup.text: Lin Yue fastened the grounded reference wick above the inner measuring square, with its lead clear of the gauge. She delivered one quarter-unit through the first arm pair and discharged. Shen timed the visible response from shelter. They repeated it with an ordinary shuttered lantern at the same height. The slower method remained usable without a cultivator. The instrument mount received its present check; neither signal reconstructed the accident. The observer kept the wick position on his drawing and the ordinary lantern for the station's later shifts.

court_weather_shift.speaker: narrator
court_weather_shift.text: The first paid shift ended with a sheet partly empty. Wind had driven mist across one viewing line, and the observer refused to move beyond the barrier to complete the missing entries. The station notice said which observations had been missed and why. A freight owner complained that a paid shift should produce a full table. Shen showed him the cancellation term beside the observer's hours. He still disliked the delay, but he could see what he had been told. The plan had bought bounded work under safe conditions, not an obligation to turn the weather into complete evidence.

court_weather_ink.speaker: narrator
court_weather_ink.text: The next bulletin carried a narrower present warning with the source location, time system, and remaining uncertainty printed beside it. It did not revise the accident report's hour. Luo put its date on the front before arranging the messenger's permitted delivery. At the lower gate, a traveler used the warning to postpone a heavy load and sent a smaller parcel by the covered path. The larger service remained delayed and payable under its own terms. A useful new reading could change an ordinary decision without claiming to settle the court's older question about who had failed first.

court_weather_close.speaker: narrator
court_weather_close.text: On Day Five, the observer closed the third shift and returned the rented instrument. The report listed performed intervals, canceled work, and the limits of the warning. It said whether the canal authority had acted, without pretending the station controlled that decision. The clerk checked expenses against the eighteen-copper shift allocation and the other budget lines. Further custody through the review depended on the permitted period; any unused reserve followed the appropriation's return rule. He Lian scheduled the Day Seven review with the injury claim still open. A completed observation plan was not a completed explanation of the sling.

ending_court_weather.speaker: narrator
ending_court_weather.text: On Day Seven, Du showed the concise order to the lower contact with his left hand; his approved response reached the bench. His clinician would determine when he could carry again. Bai received a particular maintenance question, and the equipment awaited its separate safety decision. An attendant used the dated bulletin with its uncertain interval visible. Lin Yue watched the station sheet return to its keeper. The review kept protection alive while harder questions continued. It received bounded records without demanding another climb or turning a weather warning into a verdict.

court_local_proposal.speaker: du_heng
court_local_proposal.text: The local plan spends twenty-four copper on two lower-landing sessions, four on certified messenger service, and four on the agreed additional custody period. Each session pays a minute-taker, a sheltered room, and an attendant. It does not pay every witness's missed wages or require another journey up the cliff. I approved a session offer, not a promise that my arm would permit it. If I must cancel, the writer can use my already approved account within its terms. The room's cost should not make me feel I owe the court a longer or more certain answer.

court_local_room.speaker: narrator
court_local_room.text: The hired room stood near the lower landing, sheltered from the road and separate from the lift's work area. The attendant checked its threshold before the first session. Bai could place her contract on the table without unrolling her tools. The local minute-taker read the purpose and the permitted copying scope before opening the ink. He did not have the bench's authority to change an order. His task was smaller: receive approved words and return a checkable account. Luo left the court's receiving address on the wall so a local correction would have a named destination.

court_local_turn.speaker: du_heng
court_local_turn.text: The chair supports my arm better than the upper bench did. I can answer for this interval, with a pause if I need it. The writer asked what I meant by seeing the safety rope afterward. I described where I was after the jolt and which part I could see. He read back a sentence beginning I did not see its installation. I approved that sentence. It limits the account; it does not make the part I observed useless. When my shoulder started to ache, we stopped. The unfinished question remained on the page rather than being answered for me.

court_local_absence.speaker: narrator
court_local_absence.text: Su E declined the second session because she could not leave her work. The minute-taker received that message without replacing her earlier approved statement or marking a refusal to cooperate. A neighbor who had nothing firsthand to add also stayed away. The paid room remained available for its limited interval, not transformed into an order to find more witnesses. Lin Yue returned a borrowed stool before the attendant closed the door. The minutes recorded the offers, the replies, and the work actually performed. A thin packet could be an honest result of a well-funded session.

court_local_counter.speaker: bai_qun
court_local_counter.text: The local writer let me put the full duty paragraph beside the shortened version. I described where the landing guide met the lift staff's work. That junction is precisely why we need separate responsibilities, not a convenient phrase assigning everything to whoever stood nearest. I did not add an exact accident time to make the account sound complete. My morning inspection statement remained its own statement. Before leaving, I approved only the relevant comparison and the explanation I had given. He offered to copy my whole tool inventory; I asked why it was needed, and he removed the request.

court_local_record.speaker: narrator
court_local_record.text: The messenger brought the approved local minutes with their sources and limits intact. Weather had delayed his departure, so the receipt recorded the actual arrival rather than the planned one. He Lian admitted the authorized account without treating its lower location as an inferior place to speak. The extra custody period remained subject to its agreed end and the review. The expense sheet showed two session allocations and the unused amounts, if any, rather than a fictional attendance total. The court now had a practical way to receive another limited correction without demanding another painful ascent.

ending_court_local.speaker: narrator
ending_court_local.text: At Day Seven's review, Bai kept her tools closed at the lower contact desk while its reader delivered the bench's next question. Du's injury claim stayed open, with ordinary care and medical restrictions necessary. Corrected proofs remained valid for those who attended and those who declined. The local minutes joined the original accounts without erasing them. The hired room returned to its keeper after its sessions. Lin Yue left the receiving address below. A voice could reach the bench near home, carrying pauses and limits without another funded ascent.

court_staged_proposal.speaker: luo_shan
court_staged_proposal.text: The staged plan uses twelve copper for six paid source-checking hours, eight for two specialist handling tasks, four for messenger service, and eight for a bounded storage reserve. The handling is distinct from ordinary staff copying already funded elsewhere. No stage postpones the corrected proofs or today's administrative order. Established source questions, particular maintenance claims, and unresolved cause will occupy separate named places, each with a receiving post and date. Custody beyond the Day Seven review needs renewed authority and permission; unused reserve returns. The plan makes work finite without declaring that every question fits its six hours.

court_staged_division.speaker: narrator
court_staged_division.text: He Lian approved the stage headings and crossed out a proposed box marked later miscellaneous matters. The injury claim deserved a name and receiving post, not a drawer without a date. Another heading admitted the contract's assigned scope while preserving the separate question of actual performance. The copied annex's source relation appeared beside its use limits. Bai and Du inspected the descriptions before the clerk entered them. A smaller file could still conceal a large delay; the dates prevented that convenience. The magistrate left an objection route printed under every stage, including the stage she had just ordered.

court_staged_check.speaker: narrator
court_staged_check.text: The checker began the six paid hours with the offered sources, not with every account stored nearby. He compared headings, omitted conditions, and the relation between the authorized extract and its condensed copy. When a requested page fell outside permission, he named the gap and sought a separate offer rather than taking it from the neighboring file. His time sheet recorded the request as work without pretending it had produced a finding. Luo read the bounded report aloud. The checker had established several source relationships; he had not established the private intention of the people who shortened the pages.

court_staged_handling.speaker: narrator
court_staged_handling.text: The specialist handling tasks preserved the offered exhibit condition and prepared the approved comparison surface. Neither task enlarged the evidence scope. Lin Yue watched the keeper inspect the relevant covers before opening a parcel, then close it when the permitted work was finished. The resulting note described what could be compared and which historical question the present material could not answer. It would have been easy to write examination complete and imply a broader certainty. The specialist wrote the two task names instead. The court could pay for careful hands without paying for a convenient answer about an unseen failure.

court_staged_limit.speaker: he_lian
court_staged_limit.text: The paid checks confirm the source boundaries described in their report. They do not reveal the first movement of the brake, counterweight, guide, or sling. The next particular claim must therefore identify the duty and observation it relies on, rather than inherit a conclusion from the staged headings. We have not moved the unresolved cause into a place where nobody can challenge it. The injury receiving post and review date remain printed on the notice. If a stage has been misassigned, the parties may request correction without reopening the validity of their admitted work proofs.

court_staged_delivery.speaker: narrator
court_staged_delivery.text: Mo Ran helped the messenger arrange the approved stage notices by recipient, leaving the private contents covered. Each person received the portions relevant to their reply. The storage reserve extended only the permitted custody and returned unused money when renewal was declined or unnecessary. At Day Seven, the clerk asked for the required authority rather than assuming a paid space entitled the court to keep a parcel. One keeper chose pickup. The list showed the returned item and the remaining approved copy. A better docket could follow both without treating the smaller evidence set as a disappearance.

ending_court_staged.speaker: narrator
ending_court_staged.text: Day Seven's review began with three named questions and their sources, not a broad demand that Bai explain the entire lift. Du's compensation claim had its own receiving post and still required a proper answer. The work proof correction and removal of the defective assessment remained effective. On the notice, the unsolved cause appeared without a decorative seal of certainty. Lin Yue left after checking the objection route with Luo. Outside, rain struck the covered path in uneven bursts. The docket had become smaller enough to use, and open enough to show where the court still owed its parties work.
ending_court_staged.ending: A Question in Its Proper File

court_remand_proposal.speaker: he_lian
court_remand_proposal.text: The limited remand spends twelve copper on one independent lower-landing reinspection, six on dated notices and service, six on a certified supplemental extract, and eight on conditional storage within the stated reserve. The reinspection cannot reopen the lift or replay the accident. Its maker must identify the present condition, method, source, and limit of every finding. The receiving office will answer a particular maintenance question by the review date or give a dated reason for delay. Existing protection stays in force. Further custody past Day Seven requires authority and permission, with unused reserve returned when those are not granted.

court_remand_instruction.speaker: narrator
court_remand_instruction.text: Luo read the remand instruction beside the filed accusation. The task asked about the landing and guide duties and their relation to the separate lift staff remit. It did not ask an inspector to decide every person's guilt. The notice named the receiving office, the person responsible for service, and the Day Seven review. Bai requested that the broad assessment's correction travel with it. Du requested that his shoulder restrictions not be confused with the removed work bar. Both requests appeared on the copy. A return to the lower office would not return the parties to the original defective page.

court_remand_inspection.speaker: narrator
court_remand_inspection.text: The independent inspector examined the lower landing without operating the closed goods lift. Bai offered the permitted contract comparison and answered questions about the guide's location. She did not conduct the inspection herself. The inspector marked where present condition could be observed and where historical inference would require another source. Rain interrupted one part of the work; the report retained the interruption. The twelve-copper task was bounded by its stated method, not a promise to prove the case. Bai left her tool roll tied. Being asked to explain a feature did not make her responsible for certifying everybody else's machinery.

court_remand_extract.speaker: narrator
court_remand_extract.text: The supplemental extract retained the relevant condition of the source and the permitted scope of its use. An authorized clerk certified it; Luo helped read the request and could not certify it himself. The six-copper line paid that task, not an indefinite stream of new copies. When the extract arrived, the receiving office placed it beside the remand report instead of replacing the older version. Du approved the use of his offered observation under its existing terms. A new page made the next reply more particular. It did not silently supply a new witness or a more exact accident hour.

court_remand_delay.speaker: du_heng
court_remand_delay.text: The office's notice says one inspection section was interrupted and gives the next decision date. I dislike another delay. I can still read what work happened and what did not. My proof remains admitted, the defective assessment remains set aside, and nobody has asked me to earn those things again by lifting a crate. The claim for my injury is not finished. I will bring the clinician's next permitted statement if it is relevant and I choose to offer it. For now, I need the office to keep the unanswered line where I can find it.

court_remand_review.speaker: he_lian
court_remand_review.text: At the review, we will compare the completed task with the instruction and name any remaining question. The custody reserve is money available within a limit, not permission which renews itself. Keepers may request return, and the office must obtain authority and agreement before using a further permitted period. If weather or access prevented completion, the notice will give the actual reason and a dated next step rather than marking the remand complete. Today's administrative findings survive that failure. A court which cannot finish a task on time still has the duty to make its unfinished work answerable.

ending_court_remand.speaker: narrator
ending_court_remand.text: On Day Seven, the lower contact read the bench's response to the reinspection and its historical limits. Maintenance and injury questions stayed under dated review. Du kept the order in his left pocket, apart from his clinician's note. Bai knew which particular claim she might answer and which whole-lift assignment had been rejected. The goods lift stayed closed. Lin Yue descended after delivering the approved records. Behind her, an unanswered line remained beside a date and a responsible office; below, the parties received that answer without another ascent.

court_copy_chain.speaker: luo_shan
court_copy_chain.text: Rui Fang drafted the annex from an older city classification without its correction. Ke Min added corroboration and approved the shortened words. Their retained draft identifies those separate acts. Review expected assessment to compare technical scope; assessment treated the review mark as confirmation of authority. The handoff named neither comparison responsibility. These findings explain how an unsupported broad heading survived, without proving deliberate deception or the accident's cause. The first annex remains beside its dated correction. A file-specific repair has already been acknowledged; the wider handoff problem needs a responsible receiving point rather than an impressive count of copies.

court_bench_account.speaker: he_lian
court_bench_account.text: My review book records that I approved the shortened desk summary after checking its match to the long cycle. It does not record a check of the omitted interim-reply condition. I have offered that passage so the court can examine my act as well as the clerks' acts. The adopted rule permits local checks and reasoned replies during distant searches. The summary should have preserved that. Correcting it does not secretly replace the standing calendar, and acknowledging my failure does not explain the sling's first movement. It does identify work this bench must answer for instead of sending responsibility downward.

court_witness_entry.speaker: narrator
court_witness_entry.text: The witness door stood beneath the public terrace, where rain ran down the outside of a copper canopy. Seven people waited under it, although the docket listed eleven. He Lian showed Lin Yue the attendance sheet. Each absent name had already acquired a narrow red stroke. Across the column, a clerk had written that the missing witnesses declined to assist. A woman carrying a covered bread basket pointed at her own entry. Her stroke remained even though she was standing beside the desk, still dripping from the climb.

court_witness_a1_01.speaker: he_lian
court_witness_a1_01.text: That mark means unanswered when the attendance copy closes. It ought to mean only that. The summary made it a refusal, and the summary now travels farther than this sheet. I can correct someone whom I meet here; I cannot know why each missing person stayed away. We must find out before the hearing uses their absence as a fact. The court has asked for evidence about an injury. Being able to climb these stairs should not determine whose account enters the room. Start with the summons, not an accusation.

court_witness_a1_02.speaker: narrator
court_witness_a1_02.text: The bread seller introduced herself as Su E, fifty years old, with a morning oven and two rented stalls below the eastern gate. She had come when the notice told her to come. On its lower edge, beside an embossed rain crane, the hearing time appeared as the seventh division of the second celestial watch. Su E had asked three customers to translate it. They gave three different answers. She chose the earliest, shut her stall, and waited through two shifts of clerks before her name was called.

court_witness_a1_03.speaker: lin_yue
court_witness_a1_03.text: May I copy that line and the answers you were given? Your basket can remain shut. I need the time written on the notice, the time you understood, and when you arrived. Those are different entries. We can ask the desk to preserve your attendance now, before discussing what you saw at the incident. If a customer guessed, we will describe it as a guess. The hearing should hear your observation in your own words, without pretending the confusion has supplied a missing hour for us.

court_witness_a1_04.speaker: narrator
court_witness_a1_04.text: He Lian found the original dispatch slip in a drawer of returned seals. A clerk had copied the celestial designation correctly; the fault preceded the copying. The local explanation space was blank. Instructions printed along the reverse required either a mortal bell time or a named guide, but the front had reached the town without either. Su E's three answers were added in a separate margin. He Lian left the unexplained designation visible. Changing the evidence itself would hide how a person could obey a summons and still be counted absent.

court_witness_a1_05.speaker: narrator
court_witness_a1_05.text: Outside, Mo Ran asked the waiting people which stairs they had used. A potter came up the western ramp before sunrise. A porter tried the eastern steps and turned back when their upper landing disappeared behind a closed lattice. An older witness arrived in a cart, discovered that carts were excluded, and waited by the lower gate for a promised chair. None of these routes appeared on the notice. Mo Ran sketched them on a flour sack that Su E emptied willingly, then weighed its curling corners with four smooth stones.

court_witness_a1_06.speaker: mo_ran
court_witness_a1_06.text: We have three routes and three different obstacles. I would like the people who used them to mark where they stopped. Someone reading this tomorrow must distinguish a closed gate from a difficult climb. The porter returned to his work after waiting; that does not tell us whether he rejected the hearing. The cart passenger is still below. If the court needs her today, it must arrange an actual journey, with a person responsible for meeting her. Drawing a comfortable ramp on our paper will not bring her upstairs.

court_witness_a1_07.speaker: narrator
court_witness_a1_07.text: The desk clerk offered a familiar explanation: witnesses often came early because they wanted favors. Su E set her basket on the counter and opened it. The remaining buns had collapsed under their damp cloth. She had brought them to sell while waiting, not to give to the court. He Lian asked the clerk to identify any request for a favor on the attendance form. There was none. The clerk drew a line through his inference and recorded Su E's actual arrival. The required hour still needed translation before an early or late comparison.

court_witness_a1_08.speaker: luo_shan
court_witness_a1_08.text: My room has space for six seated witnesses and one interpreter. The list describes eleven visitors, two attendants, and possibly a second interpreter. We cannot solve that by placing the rest in this corridor all day. The room beside mine is used for drying court robes until the fifth bell. If its keeper can move that work, we can open a waiting room. Someone must ask her and provide another drying place. Write down both tasks. A promise to make space is unfinished until the robe keeper has an answer.

court_witness_a1_09.speaker: narrator
court_witness_a1_09.text: Shen Qing found the robe keeper feeding charcoal into a shallow brazier. Each sleeve bore a different judge's embroidered seal, and the cloth had to be dry for the evening sitting. She rejected the terrace because rain blew under its canopy. The unused copy room had two windows, a safe hearth, and benches wide enough for hanging poles. Its paper stores would need covers. Shen Qing fetched the store steward rather than moving someone else's work without asking. The steward agreed to release the room after an inventory and a supervised transfer.

court_witness_a1_10.speaker: he_lian
court_witness_a1_10.text: The robe transfer can be ready by the fifth bell. Our witnesses need a workable summons sooner than the next celestial watch, which lasts beyond their ordinary working day. I can prepare one detailed proposal for the registrar now. We could ask for a fixed mortal hour with guaranteed arrival arrangements, or for smaller appointments that rotate around the witnesses' shifts. Both require staff and cost estimates. Choose which proposal you will help us test first. Luo Shan will ask another clerk to check the alternative while we work on ours.

court_witness_a1_fixed_1.speaker: narrator
court_witness_a1_fixed_1.text: Lin Yue helped He Lian lay a single mortal-day schedule beside the docket. A noon arrival avoided the busiest baking and unloading hours but crossed the potter's kiln opening. Su E said her assistant could cover the stall if paid; the potter could not leave a firing at that stage. They altered the plan to an afternoon hour and reserved a separate statement appointment for him. The first draft had treated eleven working lives as one convenient block. Its second version listed the exception openly, with the clerk required to receive it.

court_witness_a1_fixed_2.speaker: he_lian
court_witness_a1_fixed_2.text: This proposal asks for one shared hearing period, six chairs, covered transport from the lower gate, and a separate potter appointment. It keeps comparison between witnesses simple, but the court must not treat the exception as weaker evidence. I have put paid relief for Su E's assistant in the estimate instead of assuming the assistant will volunteer. The gate attendants need a departure hour too. If the session runs late, a messenger must warn the households waiting below. A fixed beginning is only useful when the return journey is considered.

court_witness_a1_rotating_1.speaker: narrator
court_witness_a1_rotating_1.text: Luo Shan spread eleven short appointment slips across the bench. A baker needed the afternoon; a porter could spare the interval before the evening unloading; the potter wanted the following morning after checking his kiln. Small appointments fitted those lives, but scattered comparison over two days. Luo Shan added a clerk to record each question exactly and a date when every witness could inspect the resulting transcript. Without that second meeting, the first person questioned would never learn which ambiguity later witnesses had clarified or whether a copied answer had changed meaning.

court_witness_a1_rotating_2.speaker: luo_shan
court_witness_a1_rotating_2.text: The rotating plan needs more clerk hours and less time spent waiting without pay. Its transcripts must preserve questions as well as replies. If an account changes after someone sees another statement, we will retain the first and record the reason for correction. That can improve accuracy; it can also reveal a new influence that the hearing needs to examine. We cannot pretend staggered appointments are identical to a shared session. I will write those differences beside the estimate so the registrar can choose with the witnesses rather than merely choosing for us.

court_witness_a1_11.speaker: narrator
court_witness_a1_11.text: The two proposals returned to the same desk with their separate costs. Neither supplied free labor. The registrar allowed a trial schedule while reserving the full decision for the hearing clerk. Every witness would receive a plain bell time and a named contact. Those unable to attend that slot could request an appointment without a red refusal mark appearing automatically. He Lian copied the limited approval three times: one for the gate, one for the waiting room, and one for the witnesses. The original remained in the registrar's book.

court_witness_a1_12.speaker: narrator
court_witness_a1_12.text: Su E checked her new slip against a small brass bell carried by the room attendant. Its third afternoon stroke corresponded to the ordinary market clock below. The attendant wrote both the bell and the meeting place, then read them aloud. Su E asked what would happen if rain stopped the covered-path journey. The question had no space on the printed form. He Lian added a contact at the lower gate and a rule that an interrupted journey would trigger a new appointment. Su E took the amended slip rather than the handsome original.

court_witness_a1_13.speaker: rain_heron
court_witness_a1_13.text: I can carry a light message to the lower gate before dusk. I cannot carry a passenger, and I will not fly through the inner hearing screens. The wind turns beneath that roof. Give me a sealed delivery and name someone who can receive it without climbing into my landing trough. If the gate keeper leaves, your message waits until he returns. Put that delay in your plan. You have already made one wrong absence out of waiting; do not make another by treating my arrival as his receipt.

court_witness_a1_14.speaker: narrator
court_witness_a1_14.text: He Lian addressed the packet to the lower-gate clerk and included a receipt card. The Rain Heron stood on one leg while she checked the weight, then nudged out the large brass seal that made it too heavy. A small paper seal served instead, bearing the same dispatch number.
